note: Both sets correctly capture the handrail, siding, cladding, cable railing, grade level, solar envelope, railing post, and tube-count facts, and both make the same misbinding of 2' - 9 1/2" (a finished-floor elevation) to the evacuated solar thermal tubes. Set A additionally captures the finished floor elevation with its relative-to-grade condition, an important datum Set B omits. Set B instead repeats three claims (cable railing diameter, grade level elevation, solar envelope height) in near-identical form, adding trivial redundancy without new information.
